description: Swatches panel menu commands: duplicate, delete (replacing with another swatch), merge swatches into the first, list or delete unused swatches (Select All Unused), add unnamed colours to the swatches, add the colours of items to the swatches (Color panel > Add to Swatches), make or add to a colour group (New Color Group), or ungroup a colour group

group.description: group, ungroup: the colour group name

newName.description: duplicate: name for the copy (one swatch only)

on.description: add_to_swatches: which colour of each item (default both)

replaceWith.description: delete, delete_unused: swatch that replaces the deleted ones where used (default: InDesign leaves the colour applied unnamed)

swatches.description: Swatch names: duplicate, delete, group, or merge (the first keeps its name and the others merge into it)

target.description: add_to_swatches: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: manage_swatches
title: Manage Swatches
